crossCuttingContract: A proof records a lower bound on actual renderer transport dispatch, never server snapshot time or permission authority.
Capture after URL/body preparation and before actual fetch; completion proof alone does not prevent a flush while an older observer is still waiting for a response.

The already-reviewed pending mechanism is opt-in only for known single-snapshot fetchers; duplicate capture/notify or supersession revokes and wakes waiters. Do not extend RPC whitelist for HTTP paths.

Completed proof still requires onSuccess acceptance, exact Object.is committed object, no retained error/supersession, current cache/key/owner/workspace/session/visibility lifetime and all existing revision checks. Missing required revision data cannot be treated as covered.
A helper's returned value, a server GET, or a completed Promise by itself does not establish that a real new Native window will contain fewer SQL queries.

minimalRegressionSuggestions.target: Group list in scripts/use-live-lists.live.test.tsx or focused existing integration
minimalRegressionSuggestions.positive: Actual useLiveGroupList + SWRDefaults + PersistentReadCache/hydration: observer starts before ready, real GET dispatch after ready; validated exact array commits and covers that gap without a duplicate GET.
minimalRegressionSuggestions.negative: Same setup with GET dispatched before ready/hung must perform catch-up; wrong viewer/workspace, scope change and discarded/equal-comparator object must not certify the current key. A Provider-only fixture is a negative control, not proof of middleware behavior.

minimalRegressionSuggestions.positive: Use the real middleware/provider/hydration and actual loadPendingActionPage; prove only its validated wrapper covers the ready gap and retains requestedAt/observedAt.
minimalRegressionSuggestions.negative: Wrong-owner/401/malformed array and old session cannot certify; keep the existing slow initial read/same-expiry final authoritative read and assert zero decisions. Its current test render has SWRConfig + LiveProvider but no SWRDefaults, so existing passes alone do not test the proposed optimization.

minimalRegressionSuggestions.positive: If op=view is later selected, a single validated matching action/id response commits only under that owner/session key; explicit decide count remains unchanged.
minimalRegressionSuggestions.negative: Real SWRInfinite with at least two pages, one pre-gap/cached page and one post-gap page, must still refresh the aggregate; late old-session pages and disabled synthetic empty response cannot suppress it. Keep lost-decision no-resend and old-session outcome isolation tests.
